verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Pydantic AI is model-agnostic, with built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and other providers, and that "every model [is] a string swap away". OpenAI-compatible providers work via OpenAIChatModel, an AI Gateway serves multiple models under one key, and TestModel/FunctionModel allow swapping in test doubles. A community report says some non-OpenAI models wouldn't stream for months, which points to uneven feature parity across providers rather than an inability to swap. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that switching providers needs no code changes, and evidence of consistent feature parity (streaming, structured output) across providers.
